whatItIs: QuantumKatas is an open-source project in the games and learning category. It is maintained by Microsoft and primarily looks like a Jupyter Notebook codebase. Tutorials and programming exercises for learning Q# and quantum computing

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches games and learning workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: >**We are modernizing the quantum katas experience. Please visit https://quantum.microsoft.com/experience/quantum-katas to try the new online Azure Quantum katas experience, with integrated assistance from Copilot in Azure Quantum.** For the Modern QDK repository, please visit Microsoft/qsharp. The repository also appears to be archival or no longer actively maintained, which matters when evaluating it for current production use.
whoItsFor: Beginners, educators, and curious developers who want a more approachable path into quantum concepts.
whatYouCanBuild: Get a gentler introduction before diving into full SDKs.
See how different projects teach circuits, superposition, and measurement.
